Construct coherent native packing and prove the exact conditional dummy update

Bind the same source, normalized word, complete scalar masks, positive alpha/z, strong slack and literal repunit in one constructed record; retain the conditional actual-machine halt endpoint at independent large power dimensions and unique Start.

Prove the physical single-slot update and ordinary C increment, derive the ordinary F increment only under the explicit nonwrapping inequality, and then apply the exact signed rank identity. Record independent isolated replay of all four targets, fifteen standard-only audits and matching proof objects. Keep rank-forced temporal equality, safe placement and remaining Pell witnesses explicitly open.

Record the checked model, scanner, coefficient and semantics refactors

Update stale adoption rows and document all five continuation groups: 228 net Lean lines removed across 21 files including both helpers, bringing the reviewed series to 3016. Record exact module/client/check scopes, unchanged old axiom reports, independent complete-source reviews and the bounded scanner motive repair.

Document preservation of 420 old public headers and 158 existing data-definition bodies, distinguish deferred complexity ideas from compiled results, and retain the verified decimal equation artifacts unchanged.

Prove the actual rank-step coefficient is a unit at every power dimension

Use the checked literal kernel residues, fixed-prime orders, and auxiliary Frobenius to discharge all coprimality premises for Gamma over d*120199^n. Retain independent width/count exponents, zero exponents, positivity, and the exact signed rank-factor binding.

Record full-source review and independent isolated replay of main/checks with fourteen standard-only audits and byte-identical objects. Explicitly retain nonwrapping, safe placement, and rank reachability as later construction obligations.

Construct actual affine power coordinates over the full controller modulus

Derive the fixed-factor generator identity and use the checked auxiliary prime-power order through the actual CRT ring equivalence. Construct coordinates by canonical-power injectivity and finite bijectivity; no orbit map or order premise is supplied at the literal endpoint.

Keep singleton exponents, composite fixed factors, and the insufficient-projection negative control. Independently replay all four sources/checks with fourteen standard-only axiom audits and byte-identical objects; document safe placement and rank calibration as separate obligations.

Use direct semantics simplification in object arithmetic specifications

Replace twenty manual formula-specification conversions with focused simp-only applications of Sat, scons and the existing graph equivalences. Preserve all formulas, binder coordinates, successor witnesses, constructor tags, conjunction ordering and arbitrary-model/internal-natural premises. Apply the complete eight-file packet-s group, removing 133 lines with no helper or import overhead.

Validation: all eight fresh modules, three direct semiring/polynomial/residual clients, six existing focused checks and the final axiom audit pass first try (eighteen final calls). All 107 baseline/final public axiom reports are byte-identical. Independent full review of all 1558 final lines, 120 theorem headers, 57 definition/instance regions and actual binder/semantic contracts passes on all eight hashes. No source retries, cache gaps or proof-budget changes.

Prove exact auxiliary prime-power order from the checked nontrivial lift

Derive natural domain conditions and the exact LTE valuation, then prove the generic odd-prime order theorem including modulus-p. Bind every premise to the maintained B and auxiliary=120199, with no supplied order hypothesis.

Record independent fresh capped replay of all four modules/checks, fourteen standard-only axiom audits, byte-identical objects, and explicit remaining CRT/controller/converse scope. Keep the decimal equation artifacts unchanged.

Share fixed-state and seed-shift induction in numeric scanners

Prove the two exact Nat.rec facts once in an Init-only NatIterate module and specialize all twelve scanner endpoint proofs. Keep each scanner and primitive-recursive program definition literal, retain all raw-state/fuel inputs and terminal/rejection behavior, and add no global simplifier attributes. Including the complete nineteen-line helper and four imports, remove twenty-three maintained lines.

Validation: eleven fresh source/client builds, ten existing focused checks and both public/helper audits pass (twenty-three final Lean calls); all forty-nine runtime controls are true. Twenty old axiom reports remain byte-identical and both helpers are axiom-free. Independent complete-source/recursor review passes. The initial helper statement needed explicit constant-motive annotations before the final checks; the first diagnostic is preserved separately.

Share isolated coefficient calculation across quadratic encoders

Extract the ordered coefficient-fiber calculation into a CommSemiring lemma below both ordinary and selective encoding layers. Reuse it for the diagonal, off-diagonal and canonical pair identities, and reuse selective cross-target vanishing for the multi-row support bound. The selected fiber equivalence is sufficient; unused pair sums may still collide. Preserve all weights, corrections, encoding polynomials, target positions, natural-subtraction bounds and old public statements.

The three existing modules plus the complete 32-line helper shrink from 413 to 393 lines. Four fresh modules, five direct clients, three existing diagonal/collision/signed-row/empty-family controls and both audits pass. All 24 old public axiom reports are byte-identical; the new helper uses only standard axioms. Independent complete-source and coefficient-contract review passes.

Reuse integer unit, nonnegative sum and norm obstruction lemmas

Replace repeated unit case analysis, product reordering certificates and five nonlinear square-zero deductions in ShortSystem with their library laws. Derive its auxiliary obstruction and both MinimumNorm residue obstructions from ShortEquation.strong_ne_neg_one by ring identities. Keep all polynomial/evaluator definitions and public signatures and assumptions unchanged; remove forty lines including the new lower import.

Validation: two changed modules, the planned uncached TotalDegreeBound prerequisite, three direct clients, both existing ShortEquationAxioms/ProposalAxioms checks and the final audit pass. All forty-nine old public axiom reports are byte-identical. Independent full-source and exact library-contract review passes; no raised proof budgets or source retries.

Share extraction of internal ZF axioms from sealed ZFC models

Expose the existing lower-layer proof as ObjectArithmetic.zfAxioms_of_zfc_model and retain ObjectMultiplication.axioms_of_zfc_model as its public wrapper. Update only the two local addition references, keeping all thirteen external callers and every existing public signature unchanged. Remove twelve duplicate lines without changing formulas, model assumptions, or internal omega semantics.

Validation: both named-olean module builds, three direct clients, three existing focused checks and public/helper audits pass (ten final Lean calls). Existing axiom reports are byte-identical and model extraction remains choice-free. The complete final sources and six-axiom bridge contracts passed independent static review.

Merge reviewed origin/main coefficient, decoder and carrier proof reductions

Read all six maintained proof diffs, the full127-line coefficient module and upstream fresh-check receipts. Preserve executable definitions, all145 old public headers and current equation artifacts. Upstream records the decoder helper standard-choice axiom change, complete raw-input/fuel controls, unchanged graph/carrier data and fresh dependent checks. This merge adopts proof refactors only and claims no new full closure replay; retain the complete constructed-mask and controller-residue checkpoints.

Construct the complete native masks and positive scalar transport witnesses

Derive cell-origin carries and the exceptional origin mask from actual temporal matching; prove all916 padding tests from exact reflected residues; exhaust every physical field and pack the full highPort*J−1 mask for the same constructed normalization. Construct positive alpha/z, strong slack, signed C recovery and literal transport factor1 without desired mask, carry, strict F or quotient premises. Record full source reads, eight fresh bounded root module/check passes,32 standard-only or axiom-free reports and independent isolated origin/high-mask replays with identical objects. Leave actual rank-controlled displacement, safe dummy corrections, remaining positive Pell witnesses and the equation converse open; preserve decimal equation artifacts.

Prove the three literal kernel residues and discharge the finite H premises

Reindex the original complete kernel through the checked physical order and prove a generic semiring Horner identity retaining protected Start,941 selectors,34 controls and three bare monomials. Kernel-check177 short modular blocks and derive original K residues26/1995/114787 plus unconditional H residues29/674/36379. Record full root source review, fresh author and isolated independent main/check passes,13 standard-only reports, byte-identical objects and independent whole-integer corroboration. Actual power orbit, safe controller realization and the equation converse remain open.

Proof simplification proposal(s)

Reuse core Option.map injectivity in parent-code lookup

Replace the repeated four-way Option case proof with
Option.map_injective judgmentCode_injective. The surrounding list-map
argument, checker data, fuel premise and every public statement are unchanged.
This integrates the remaining packet-e AnnotatedParents proof hunk and
removes two more source lines after the separate raw-decoder refactor.

Validation: inspected the repository-pinned core theorem, rebuilt the module
and AnnotatedLine client, ran the existing AnnotatedParents checks and compared
the lookup_code_maps_iff axiom report before/after. All four final Lean calls
pass; the old axiom report is byte-identical. No executable definitions,
imports, acceptance/rejection controls or new assumptions are introduced.

Merge origin/main research packet placement before high-mask construction

Incoming 2026-10-26w placement and new incoming archives are inert research material. Confirmed no maintained Lean, tools, equation or toolchain delta. Preserve reviewed controller subset, copy-mask, stronger-bound and physical-order checkpoints.

Prove constructed copy masks, stronger word bounds and the complete physical ordering

Derive nine temporal copies, eight spatial copies and the signed marker source from actual marked matching and the same constructed carry normalization. Prove exact2009/2010 kernel fields and resets, F<q/radix and the exclusive C prefix bound. Check all941 non-Start coefficients in bounded blocks, derive full942 coverage and bind every cached position to the actual printed floor rank generically. Record root full-source review, fresh bounded copy replay, isolated independent top/data/order replays,46 standard-only audits and byte-identical objects. Preserve zero-stride/N=1 interfaces and keep padding/origin, actual K residues, controller and polynomial converse open.
Proof simplification proposal(s)

Construct every affine controller residue with a subset and one Boolean term

Choose epsilon0/1 through the actual auxiliary-prime projection, derive a least positive cardinality coprime to every prime power, and lift the remaining target using canonical natural division. Compose with the explicit affine-coordinate injection to construct a distinct finite subset with the prescribed target sum and exact size0<a<C0. Preserve C0 composite, exponent0 and T=1 helper controls. Record four fresh bounded author and isolated independent replays, byte-identical objects and four standard-only axiom audits. Leave actual power-orbit identification, safe positions and rank correction explicit.

Simplify evaluator transport and positive carrier proof wrappers

Apply run_map's induction hypothesis directly to the same appended value
buffer and use the existing list-map laws. Cast the complete first-Pell gap
disjunction instead of repeating its two cases. Simplify the canonical parent
zero from its six identities and infer each retained coordinate directly in
drop/restore positivity, keeping n/h/tau branches explicit.

Only proof bodies change; every original type, positivity/rank hypothesis,
coordinate map, circuit evaluator and arithmetic definition is unchanged.
The three files shrink from 604 to 573 lines, removing 31 lines.

Validation: three touched module builds plus three previously uncached
Carrier65/CarrierRankBounds/Carrier65Witness prerequisites pass; fresh
ArithmeticDAGSemantics/ArithmeticDAGPowers/Carrier66Source clients, five
existing focused checks and the final axiom audit all pass (15 final calls).
The two cached evaluator baseline axiom reports are byte-identical; other
printed sets are standard, with canonical_zero using only propext. Focus
controls retain invalid references, both coordinate maps and the excluded
rank-one Pell witness. Independent exact-final source review passes.

Share raw-parent reconstruction and tree decoder invariants

Prove raw-parent acceptance by reconstructing the arbitrary raw code as a
list inside Prop with existing decodeTable_total/tableCode_of_decode, then
reuse check_lists. The checker still receives exactly the old fuel and raw
input; no well-formedness or extra fuel hypothesis is added. Share the tree
requote and depth induction in decode_spec and keep both existing theorems
as projections. All 32 executable definitions, Tree data, imports and old
public theorem types remain unchanged.

The two files shrink from 626 to 573 physical lines, removing 53 lines
(54 nonblank) and 1673 bytes including the new invariant. Existing rejection,
malformed-input and fuel behavior remain literal unchanged.

Validation: five fresh source/olean builds, five existing focused checks,
public/helper axiom audits all pass; all 26 existing runtime controls are
true. Independent full exact-final source/decoder-contract review passes.
The shared depth projection now inherits standard Classical.choice through
Nat.pair_unpair, changing its old [propext,Quot.sound] set to the standard
three; the other 12 audited old results are unchanged. check_sound and
checkWithFuel_sound retain their choice-free standard sets. No new axioms
or explicit premises are introduced.

Share coefficient-envelope proofs across the 22 native rows

Replace 22 private per-row bound proofs and their dispatch with one finite
row proof using the existing abs_ite_le helper and seven shared nonnegative
facts. All scalar leaves of all 22 literal recipes are bounded by the same
envelope. Retain all eight public theorem signatures, all four port hypotheses,
the envelope definition, correction, masks, support data and published strict
bounds. Integrate packet d exactly, without mixing the distinct packet h variant.

NativeCoefficientBounds shrinks from 679 lines/39920 bytes to 127/5492,
removing 552 lines and 34428 bytes including helper and option overhead.
Only the combined row theorem has a local 2000000-heartbeat allowance.

Validation: named-olean module build, existing NativeCoefficientBounds check,
and fresh NativeNineSource52/NativeNineEquation52 clients all pass first try;
all eight old axiom reports are byte-identical. Independent full exact-final
source/recipe review passes. Module build took 160.69 seconds and 2139032 KiB
peak RSS with -j1, without a memory cap. Compiled olean grew from 1372672 to
3686520 bytes: this improves source maintenance, with no compilation-speed
or compiled-size improvement claimed. Further proof-term sharing is being
investigated separately from this checked checkpoint.

Place the new-structures DiophantineConsistency Lean simplification packet

commit 553a5f7a46. It is placed as
research/lean-proof-simplification/2026-10-26w; members byte-identical

additionCancellationForm and the NoZeroDivisors instance. The two modules

Construct carries bounded by57 for the literal K convolution plus arbitrary binary rotation, with exact predecessor recurrence, normalized digits and actual product congruence before any strict positive F is assumed. Prove separate positive-digit/slack-digit bounds and marked-source positivity. Share signed integer-root recovery across finalizers

Recover the actual signed rational roots as their integral numerators once
a nonzero power is integral, then prove separated integer-root recovery once

MarginFinalizer wrapper instead of reconstructing arbitrary square roots and

Retain all existing theorem statements, omega/weight nonzero conditions,
separation and bounded-radicand premises, imports and polynomial norm/value

Construct modular interval subsets with exact cardinality and prescribed sums
